name: MSI PRO MP242 E14A 23.8 FHD 144Hz IPS Business Productivity Monitor
shortDescription: MSI PRO MP242 E14A 23.8 FHD 144Hz IPS Business Monitor (23.8 Inch Full HD 1920x1080 / Smooth 144Hz Refresh Rate / IPS Wide Viewing Angle / 1ms MPRT / 121% sRGB Color Gamut / HDMI, DP & D-Sub VGA Connectivity / PS5, X
descriptionHtml:
MSI PRO MP242 E14A 23.8 FHD 144Hz IPS Business Monitor (23.8 Inch Full HD 1920x1080 / Smooth 144Hz Refresh Rate / IPS Wide Viewing Angle / 1ms MPRT / 121% sRGB Color Gamut / HDMI, DP & D-Sub VGA Connectivity / PS5, Xbox, PC & Mac Compatible / HDMI CEC & MSI Power Link / Built-in Speakers / 2 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Enhance your daily workflow and visual performance with the MSI PRO MP242 E14A 23.8-inch FHD IPS monitor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 2-Year Local Agent Warranty. Featuring a crisp 1920x1080 Full HD resolution paired with an ultra-smooth 144Hz refresh rate and an impressive 121% sRGB color gamut coverage, this versatile display is built for both content editing and high-speed multi-platform gaming across PC, Mac, PS5, and Xbox consoles. Equipped with HDMI 1.4, DisplayPort 1.2a, D-Sub VGA ports, built-in stereo speakers, and MSI EyesErgo technology, it ensures exceptional color accuracy and long-term viewing comfort.
